profile.name: I-7540D CAN总线以太网网关
profile.name_en: I-7540D CAN Bus to Ethernet Gateway
profile.description: 这是一种将以太网/TCP连接转换为CAN总线通信的网关设备，用于把实验室电脑、测试台或自动化系统接入CAN网络。它适合用于CAN设备联机、总线状态监测、通信参数配置以及标准CAN数据帧的收发。
profile.description_en: This device is a gateway that bridges Ethernet/TCP connections to a CAN bus network. It is used to connect laboratory computers, test benches, or automation systems to CAN-based equipment for bus status monitoring, communication configuration, and transmission and reception of standard CAN data frames.
